newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian brewery breaks new record.
newsitem.headline: Croatian brewery breaks new record.

text.p: Croatian brewery Karlovacka Pivovara, Chile's Cervecerias subsidiary, broke new price record on Zagreb bourse on Thursday in otherwise slow trade, market participants said.
"It is rising as we speak," Zoran Ilic of Consult Invest told Reuters. "If it continues at this pace it may go as far as 680 kuna before the week ends," he added.
Karlovacka peaked at 652 kuna after trading in 615-652 kuna range selling 800 shares by 1000 GMT. Its previous high was 610 kuna in early July.

Zagrebacka Banka's preference E-series stock continued to hit new highs, peaking at 1,600 kuna, up from its record price of 1,550 kuna on Wednesday. Traders said there was space left for further growth.
The preference stock followed in the footsteps of Zagrebacka's ordinaries which saw a steep steep rise in the past days.
